verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Simular publishing its own MCP server (sai-mcp) that other agents such as Claude Code connect to. That is the server role, the opposite direction from this story. Nothing in the pack shows Sai acting as an MCP client that accepts user-supplied MCP servers and calls their tools, and its skills feature is a different extension mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
